title: Answer
description:
The rest still held out is not the rest a later leader gave in the land. The land was real, and it was entered, and it was not this rest.

God rested by ceasing from His works. That rest remains open for the people of God.

Those who have believed enter it. Those who refused, though they had heard, did not. Today still demands that hearing.

The one who has entered has ceased from his own works, as God ceased from His. Rest is not idleness. It is the end of the works that cannot give this rest.

A voice still says Today long after the land was settled, because settling the land did not finish the promise.
